title: Dashing Away Emoji 💨 Meaning: Speed, Smoke or a Fart
description: 💨 is a puff of air left behind by something moving fast. It means speed and quick exits, and it is also used for wind, vaping, smoke and fart jokes. Details here.
summary: The 💨 dashing away emoji is the puff of dust cartoons draw behind a character who has just sped off. It means moving fast or leaving quickly. People also use it for wind, for smoke and vaping, and, very commonly, as a fart.
meaning: In comics and animation, a character who bolts leaves a little cloud hanging where they stood. That is what 💨 depicts, and why its name is “dashing away” instead of “wind” or “cloud.” Placed after a runner, a car or any object, it makes that thing look fast: 🏃💨, 🚗💨. Used alone, it means “I'm out of here,” whether the sender is rushing to work or fleeing an awkward conversation.

Speed in the abstract follows from that. Something that happened quickly, a weekend that vanished, money that disappeared the moment it arrived, a product that sold out, can all take the puff. So can things that are literally gone: “my motivation 💨.” The emoji suggests an exit so sudden that only the dust remains.

The most popular unofficial meaning is flatulence. The cloud looks like a puff of gas, and “fart” is even among its listed keywords. Sent after 🍑 or next to a face holding its nose, or simply in reply to “who did that?”, it is toilet humor understood across age groups. Children discover this use early, and plenty of adults never abandon it.

Smoke is the other major reading. It stands for exhaled vapor or smoke in posts about vaping, cigarettes, hookah and cannabis, often beside 🍃 or 😮‍💨. Car culture uses it for exhaust, burnouts and tire smoke. It also serves as wind in weather talk, a gust on a blustery day, and for breath in the cold or a sigh of relief.

contexts.label: In texting
contexts.body: It most often means hurry. “On my way 💨” promises speed; “gotta go 💨” ends a chat briskly. It is also the visual for dodging something, such as leaving before the bill arrives or slipping out of a party early. Among friends, a lone 💨 with no context is frequently a fart joke.

contexts.label: In sports and cars
contexts.body: Sprinters, wingers and wide receivers who outrun defenders get the puff in highlight captions, as do fast laps and quick launches in motorsport. Car accounts use it for acceleration and for smoke from a burnout. It praises pace in the way 💪 praises strength.

contexts.label: For smoking and vaping
contexts.body: Here the cloud is exhaled smoke. People use it in captions about vape tricks, a smoke break or getting high, and dealers and buyers sometimes use it as shorthand for vapes or cannabis. In this sense it is frequently paired with a leaf, a cloud or the exhaling face.

contexts.label: In humor
contexts.body: The fart reading powers a great many jokes. It follows bean and burrito emojis, appears in memes about yoga class and elevators, and is used to tease a friend. It is juvenile by design. With people who share that sense of humor it is harmless; elsewhere it can seem crude.

examples.meaning: The sender is hurrying to arrive.

examples.text: Saw my ex at the store and 💨
examples.meaning: They left immediately to avoid an encounter.
The money was spent almost as soon as it arrived.
A fart joke; someone has passed gas.

examples.text: Windy enough to lose a hat today 💨
examples.meaning: A literal comment on strong wind.

examples.text: Stepping out for a quick one 💨
examples.meaning: Going outside for a smoke or vape break.

combos.meaning: Running off fast, either hurrying somewhere or escaping a situation.
A fart, stated as plainly as emojis allow.
Exhaling smoke or vapor, or a long sigh of relief.

confusedWith.difference: 🌬️ is a face blowing a stream of air and is the emoji designed for wind and cold weather. 💨 is the trail left by movement. People use both for windy days, but only dashing away implies someone ran off.
☁️ is a weather cloud, still and in the sky. 💨 has motion lines and sits at ground level in cartoons. A cloud means overcast; the puff means speed, smoke or gas.
💦 shows drops of liquid for sweat, water or sexual slang. The two can look alike in small pale-blue renderings, but 💨 is air, not water, and carries different jokes.

avoid: Do not use the fart joke with people you do not know well or in professional chats.
Avoid it in posts where a smoking or drug reference could cause problems, since many readers will see that meaning.
Skip it when replying to something serious, where a quick-exit symbol looks like you are brushing the person off.
design: A small cloud of dust or air with trailing lines showing that it is being left behind by something in motion. Most vendors draw it in white, grey or pale blue, with the puff on one side and streaks on the other. It derives from manga and cartoon shorthand for a fast getaway and has been standard since 2010.

faqs.a: Usually that someone is moving fast or leaving quickly, as in “on my way” or “I'm gone.” Depending on the conversation it can also be a gust of wind, a puff of smoke or a fart. The emoji beside it generally settles which.

Very often, yes. The puff resembles gas and the emoji's keywords include the word. If it follows a peach, a food joke or a complaint about a smell, that is the meaning. It is childish humor and not offensive in itself.

faqs.q: What does 💨 mean in smoking or vaping slang?
faqs.a: It represents exhaled smoke or vapor. People add it to posts about vapes, cigarettes, hookah or weed, and it can be shorthand for the products themselves. Paired with a leaf it normally refers to cannabis.
Its official name is dashing away, though some systems have labeled it dash symbol or dash. It represents the dust cloud left by a cartoon character who runs off at high speed.
Someone running fast. It is used for rushing to get somewhere, for exercise, and for comically fleeing a situation, such as leaving the room when chores are mentioned.
